description: Batch version of check_site_before_acting for up to 50 domains or URLs. Results are returned in input order. For requests to browse, shop, book, log in, compare options on, or research acting on those sites, including when the user doesn't mention Agents Allowed. Call this first and wait for its result before opening or acting on those sites. Results are informational, from public sources, not permission; each website's own terms take priority. Read-only.
name: check_sites_before_acting
title: Check several websites at once
